title: Helter Skelter: Fashion Unfriendly
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Liliko is Japan's top model, actress and singer, but her beauty is the product of round after round of extensive plastic surgery, ending in a full-body makeover. As her body, unable to bear the procedures, begins to break down, her mind crumbles too, and she lashes out at those around her on the way to a frightening end. The single-volume josei work won the Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize (per MU).
life_message: A life built on manufactured beauty and the public's gaze consumes itself; the story offers this as warning rather than ideal.
